name: Kaite Aru
source:
The main character Yamadera Miyako is a normal middle school student.

One day, the words "You will die after 4 days" appear in her room.
Since that day, many weird things started to happen around her.

The incident gradually start to involve people around her.

Can you find out the truth, and disband from the curse of death?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE051251.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公山寺都是一名普通的初中生。

某天，她的房间里出现了一行字：“你将在四天后死去。”
从那天起，各种怪事开始接连发生在她身边。

事件也渐渐将周围的人卷入其中。

你能查明真相，解除这道死亡诅咒吗？
